description: A session can record that its open work is waiting and why; the Stop hook honours that hold only for the keys it holds, bounds its blocks at three in a row on the same keys, no hint suggests a forced merge, and the stop count stays out of version control.

specs.description: Each uncommitted file is its own item, keyed by its path
specs.given: a temporary git repository with two uncommitted files, src/a.rs and src/b.rs
specs.when: the open work is listed
specs.then: there are two uncommitted items with keys `uncommitted:src/a.rs` and `uncommitted:src/b.rs`, and each item's text is what is printed

specs.description: Task, close-out, ADR and unpushed items carry their documented keys
specs.given: an open task titled 'Write the parser', the close-out steps for land and for closing ADR-2611220204 still open, ADR-2611220204 open, and a branch ahead of its upstream origin/main
specs.when: the open work is listed
specs.then: the keys include `task:Write the parser`, `closeout:land`, `closeout:close:ADR-2611220204`, `adr:ADR-2611220204` and `unpushed:origin/main`

specs.description: An unlanded branch is keyed by its name and tip sha
specs.given: an unlanded branch feat/x whose tip is commit T
specs.when: the open work is listed
specs.then: the unlanded item's key is `unlanded:feat/x@T`

specs.description: A task's key does not change when its position or marker changes
specs.given: an open task titled 'Write the parser' whose printed text carries its position and a `[ ]` marker
specs.when: another task is added before it, or it is started so its marker becomes `[>]`
specs.then: its printed text may change, but its key is still `task:Write the parser`

specs.description: A new commit on a branch does not keep the old key
specs.given: an unlanded branch feat/x with key `unlanded:feat/x@T1`
specs.when: a new commit T2 is made on feat/x
specs.then: the item's key is `unlanded:feat/x@T2` and no longer equals `unlanded:feat/x@T1`

specs.description: The key is a function of the work, not of the printed text
specs.given: any set of open items of any kind
specs.when: something changes that only affects printed text (counts, positions, markers, other items being added or closed)
specs.then: every item that is still the same work keeps the same key, every item has a non-empty key of its kind's documented form, and two different pieces of open work never share a key

specs.description: A hold records the reason, time and blocking keys
specs.given: a session with open work whose blocking keys are `unlanded:feat/x@T` and `closeout:land`
specs.when: the session runs `hexa loop hold 'waiting on owner approval'`
specs.then: this session's entry in `.hexa/loop.json` holds the reason 'waiting on owner approval', a time, and exactly the keys `unlanded:feat/x@T` and `closeout:land`

specs.description: A second hold replaces the first and keeps it in history; --clear removes it
specs.given: a session holding with reason 'waiting on tests'
specs.when: it runs `hexa loop hold 'waiting on review'`, then later `hexa loop hold --clear`
specs.then: after the second hold the active hold's reason is 'waiting on review' and 'waiting on tests' is in the entry's hold history; after --clear there is no active hold

specs.description: A blank reason is refused and nothing is written
specs.given: a session with open work and a known `.hexa/loop.json`
specs.when: it runs `hexa loop hold ''` or `hexa loop hold '   '`
specs.then: the command fails and `.hexa/loop.json` is byte-for-byte unchanged

specs.description: A hold is refused when nothing is open
specs.given: a session with no open work
specs.when: it runs `hexa loop hold 'waiting'`
specs.then: the command fails and `.hexa/loop.json` is unchanged

specs.description: A hold does not loosen any other check
specs.given: a session holding on its open work, including an unlanded branch
specs.when: it runs `task done` on a close-out step, `loop stage done`, or the landing check
specs.then: each refuses exactly as it does without a hold

specs.description: Resume does not carry a hold into a new session
specs.given: a session with an active hold
specs.when: `hexa loop resume` starts a new session from it
specs.then: the new session has no active hold

specs.description: While the hold covers everything open, the stop goes through with one line
specs.given: a session whose hold, reason 'waiting on owner approval', covers every open item's key, three items in all
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is fed a Stop payload for this session
specs.then: the stop is let through, with one line naming 'waiting on owner approval' and saying three items wait

specs.description: An active hold is shown by `hexa loop` and at session start
specs.given: a session with an active hold whose reason is 'waiting on review'
specs.when: `hexa loop` runs, and the SessionStart summary is printed
specs.then: both print the active hold and the reason 'waiting on review'

specs.description: Work opened after the hold still blocks, and only it is listed
specs.given: a session holding on `uncommitted:src/a.rs` and `unlanded:feat/x@T1`
specs.when: src/b.rs is then modified, a task 'Fix docs' is added and a commit T2 is made on feat/x, and `hexa hook stop` is run
specs.then: the stop is blocked, and the block's reason lists `src/b.rs`, 'Fix docs' and feat/x at T2, and does not list src/a.rs

specs.description: A hold whose keys have all closed is inert
specs.given: a session whose hold's keys have all since closed, and new open work not in the hold
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run
specs.then: the hook ignores the hold and blocks on the new work as if there were no hold, `.hexa/loop.json` is not written, and `hexa loop` shows the hold as stale

specs.description: An item blocks if and only if its key is not in an active hold
specs.given: any session, any set of open items and any hold, or no hold
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run
specs.then: the items the hook would block on are exactly the open items whose keys are not in the active hold (all of them when the hold is absent or stale), and the block's reason lists only those items

specs.description: After three blocks on the same keys, later stops go through with the list
specs.given: a session with the same unheld open work across stops
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run five times
specs.then: stops 1 to 3 are blocked; stops 4 and 5 are let through and each prints the list of open work

specs.description: When the keys change the count starts again
specs.given: a session that has been blocked three times on the same keys and let through on the fourth stop
specs.when: a new file is modified and the session stops again
specs.then: that stop is blocked as the first of a new run, and `stop-blocks.json` records count 1 and the new keys

specs.description: A count from an older hexa is read as a count with no keys
specs.given: `.hexa/stop-blocks.json` with this session's entry as the bare number 2
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run with open work
specs.then: the file is read without error as count 2 with no keys, and the session's entry then holds a count and the keys blocked on

specs.description: A let-through does not reset the bound into a cycle
specs.given: a session with the same unheld open work across stops
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run eight times with nothing changing
specs.then: no stop after the third is blocked: there is no second run of three blocks

specs.description: The session's entry is removed when nothing is open
specs.given: a session with an entry in `stop-blocks.json`
specs.when: all its work is closed and `hexa hook stop` is run
specs.then: the stop goes through and the session has no entry in `stop-blocks.json`

specs.description: No stop is blocked more than three times in a row on the same keys
specs.given: any sequence of stops in one session, with any open work changing in any way between stops
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` is run for each
specs.then: for every run of consecutive stops whose unheld blocking keys are equal, at most the first three are blocked, and every stop after them in that run is let through with the list printed

specs.description: The unlanded hint names a landing that keeps the branch's commits
specs.given: an unlanded branch feat/x whose base main is an ancestor of it
specs.when: the unlanded item's fix is printed
specs.then: it names `git merge --ff-only feat/x` run from the base's checkout

specs.description: When the base has moved the hint names merge, re-gate, fast-forward
specs.given: an unlanded branch feat/x whose base main is not an ancestor of it
specs.when: the hint is printed
specs.then: it says to merge the base into the branch, re-run the gate, then fast-forward

specs.description: No hint names a forced worktree merge
specs.given: the situations that print each of the five hints: an unlanded item, a rebase conflict on landing, the worktree merge-order note, a SubagentStop with open work, and an ADR doctor finding
specs.when: each hint is printed
specs.then: none contains `hexa dev worktree merge` together with `--force`

specs.description: Every landing hint keeps the branch's commits
specs.given: any branch and base, in any state that produces one of the five hints
specs.when: the hint is printed
specs.then: it never contains `--force` for a merge, and the landing it names is either `git merge --ff-only <branch>` from the base's checkout or merge the base into the branch, re-run the gate, then fast-forward

specs.description: `hexa init` ignores stop-blocks.json
specs.given: a fresh temporary git repository
specs.when: `hexa init` runs
specs.then: `.hexa/.gitignore` lists `stop-blocks.json` with the task ledger's entries, and `git status` does not show `.hexa/stop-blocks.json` once it exists

specs.description: The Stop hook covers a project that never re-ran init
specs.given: a repository initialised by an older hexa whose `.hexa/.gitignore` does not list `stop-blocks.json`
specs.when: `hexa hook stop` first writes a count
specs.then: `.hexa/.gitignore` now lists `stop-blocks.json` and `git status` shows no untracked `.hexa/stop-blocks.json`

specs.description: Ignoring the stop count does not duplicate or drop the ledger's entries
specs.given: a `.hexa/.gitignore` already listing the ledger's entries and `stop-blocks.json`
specs.when: `hexa init` runs again and the Stop hook writes a count
specs.then: `stop-blocks.json` appears exactly once and the ledger's entries are all still present
